OpenMalaria XML snippets, as text

Source: R/xml_export.R
get_OM_xml.Rd

Writes the entomology and the vector control of an OpenMalaria scenario (schema 44, or schema) as XML text, to paste into an existing scenario, without openMalariaUtilities. The vector control snippets are those that define_OM_vector_control and deploy_OM_vector_control write into a baseList (same lists and checks):

  • entomology: the <vector> element, with one <anopheles> per mosquito population of om_ento and the declaration of the non-human hosts, to paste inside <entomology> (replacing its <vector>). Same structure as openMalariaUtilities::defineEntomology(), but with the animal host parameters of om_ento (defineEntomology() writes fixed values); the placeholders of om_ento$seasonalityParameters are kept (contributions "@contrib_<population>@" and monthly "@m1@", ..., "@m12@"). The annualEIR values are relative contributions: add scaledAnnualEIR (the total EIR) to <entomology>;

  • define: the <component> elements of the intervention, to paste inside <interventions><human>;

  • deploy: its <deployment> (all components, so that all effects reach the same people, and one <deploy> per campaign), to paste inside <interventions><human> after all <component> elements (OpenMalaria requires the components first);

  • add_hosts and modify_hosts: dummy-host interventions only (schema >= 46), the host-seeking killing as one dummy host per campaign (<nonHumanHosts> elements, with their deployment dates, to paste inside <interventions><addNonHumanHosts>) and the decays of their availability (<intervention> elements, to paste inside <interventions><nonHumanHostsModifications>); see define_OM_vector_control.

Placeholders (coverages, and the values that vary, as in define_OM_vector_control()) are kept in the text; om_scenario_values(scenarios, xml) fills them in a scenario table (the result keeps the record of the intervention and its schedule). Printing the result shows each snippet with a comment saying where to paste it. For several interventions, call the function once per intervention (with entomology = FALSE after the first).

Usage

get_OM_xml(
  om_ento,
  interv = NULL,
  schedule = NULL,
  end_date = NULL,
  intervention_type = c("ITN", "IRS"),
  name = NULL,
  subpop = NULL,
  cumulative = FALSE,
  minAge = NULL,
  maxAge = NULL,
  entomology = TRUE,
  decay = c("fixed", "placeholder"),
  schema = 44
)

# S3 method for class 'om_xml'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

om_ento

Output of get_OM_ento_snippet: written as the entomology snippet, and used for the mosquito populations of the interventions.

interv

Intervention from om_vector_control (or an object from build_intervention), or a named list of them (template, see define_OM_vector_control). NULL (default): entomology only.

schedule, end_date

As in deploy_OM_vector_control: schedule is needed with interv.

intervention_type

"ITN" (acts in bed) or "IRS" (acts on indoor resting mosquitoes, or indoor biting ones with get_OM_ento_snippet(irs_exposure = "indoor_biting")).

name

Name of the intervention, used for component ids and placeholders. Default: for a named list, intervention_type; for one intervention, the name of an om_vector_control() specification, else the description of a build_intervention() object unless "custom", else intervention_type. In placeholders, <name> is the name with each run of characters other than letters and digits replaced by _ (e.g. "Interceptor G2" gives "@Interceptor_G2_deterrency@").

subpop

Optional sub-population id suffix: the deployment is restricted to the sub-population "<name>-<subpop>" (restrictToSubPop). This and the next arguments: standard model only.

cumulative

Logical (default FALSE): cumulative coverage (cumulativeCoverage, people already covered are not redeployed), measured on "<name>-<subpop>" or the first component.

minAge, maxAge

Optional age limits of the deployment, in years (numbers or placeholders): both or neither (all ages), e.g. minAge = 0, maxAge = 5 for under-fives. Several age groups: one deploy per group.

entomology

Logical (default TRUE): include the entomology snippet.

decay

"fixed" (default: decays written from the interventions) or "placeholder" (decay parameters as placeholders, e.g. when the attrition varies between scenarios).

schema

OpenMalaria schema version of the scenario (default 44). Dummy-host interventions need 46 or later (checked with 49); from 49, the entomology has no propInfected / propInfectious.

x

Object of class om_xml.

...

Not used.

Value

Object of class om_xml: named list with entomology, define, deploy, add_hosts and modify_hosts, each a single string (XML text) or NULL.

See also

define_OM_vector_control, om_scenario_values

Examples

itn = om_vector_control(
    c(Deterrency = 0.5, PrePrandial = 0.4, PostPrandial = 0.3),
    halflife_attrition = 2 * 365, shape_attrition = 2, name = "ITN")
om_ento = get_OM_ento_snippet("Anopheles gambiae ss/coluzzii",
                              activity = def_activity_patterns())
#> get_OM_ento_snippet: annualEIR = a placeholder @contrib_<population>@ for the relative contribution of each population (values: om_ento_values()); set the total EIR with scaledAnnualEIR (e.g. defineEntomology(..., scaledAnnualEIR = "@EIR@")).
schedule = data.frame(date = c("2021-01-01", "2024-01-01"),
                      coverage = c("@cov2021@", "@cov2024@"))
xml = get_OM_xml(om_ento, itn, schedule)
